'''Olankur''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="ImpCom" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Located on the southwest [[Ocean/Legends|coast]] of the planet's northern continent, Olankur was a significant distance from Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]].<ref name="ImpCom" /> Like most of Mandalore's northern hemisphere, Olankur possessed an abundance of [[veshok]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

A [[Olankur hunting lodge|hunting lodge]] was built in Olankur, and later abandoned at a point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Fenn Shysa]] met with the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] at the Olankur lodge to discuss issues pertaining to the future of Mandalore.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The region of Olankur first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].

Olankur's name appears to be derived from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]], specifically the words ''olan'', meaning "hundred", and ''kurshi'', meaning "tree".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
